description: This file defines the handler class for Pydantic AI agents in the A2A protocol. It provides methods to handle both non-streaming and fake streaming requests to Pydantic AI agents, integrating external transformation utilities and logging functionalities.

classes.name: PydanticAIHandler
classes.description: Handler class providing static methods to process requests to Pydantic AI agents, including non-streaming and fake streaming functionalities.
